description: Schematische weergave van het Belgische spoornetwerk - Visualisation schématique du réseau ferré Belge - Schematic vizualisation of the Belgian arilway is a dataset listed in transportdata.be, a national access point for transport data, published or maintained by Infrabel. Two datasets give for the Infrabel network The Railway line sections: Segmentation of the rail network according to the characteristics of the infrastructure and the possibilities of operation. This list includes the route and technical characteristics of the line sections. Coverage: Belgium (see the dataset page for the exact area). The portal lists 2 resources in JSON. The data standards named are other. The national access point types are MMTIS. The portal shows 2024-12-18 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC0-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support mobility and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-transportdata-be-national-access-point.
